name: Epaphras
overview: Epaphras is presented in Scripture as a devoted servant and faithful minister of Christ who closely partnered with the Apostle Paul in ministry. He is described as one of the Colossians themselves, fervently laboring in prayer for their spiritual maturity and completeness in God's will. Additionally, Epaphras is recognized as a fellow prisoner with Paul, highlighting his commitment and suffering for the gospel alongside the apostle.
